mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vector_sync_jobs (memory_id, user_id, version, state, attempts, next_attempt_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{memoryId}, #{userId}, 1, 'pending', 0, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE version=version+1, state='pending', attempts=0, next_attempt_at=VALUES(next_attempt_at), lease_until=NULL, last_error_code=NULL, updated_at=VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT memory_id AS memoryId, user_id AS userId, version, attempts FROM vector_sync_jobs WHERE (state='pending' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (state='processing' AND lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY next_attempt_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM vector_sync_jobs WHERE memory_id=#{memoryId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND version=#{version} AND state='processing'
